overall_summary: Iteration 2 successfully completed prompt migration to YAML format. All 6 prompts (5 jobTaskGeneratorAgents + 1 workflowGeneratorAgents) have been migrated with complete metadata and proper structure. All tests pass (68/68), static analysis shows zero errors, and PromptLoader correctly loads all YAML prompts. However, API extensions and end-to-end scenario testing remain pending.

test_cases.evidence: All 6 prompts loaded successfully with complete metadata (description, version, agent_type, purpose, system_prompt). Test: test_yaml_load.py shows 6/6 prompts OK.

All 5 prompts migrated: requirement_clarification (1821 chars), task_breakdown (3128 chars), interface_schema (3950 chars), evaluation (4649 chars), validation_fix (2763 chars).
